title: Temüjin proclaimed Chinggis Khan
summary: A kurultai names Temüjin Chinggis Khan, the starting gun of the Mongol Empire.
body: Within two generations Mongol armies had redrawn Eurasia. The empire was violent and also a structure for trade, relay posts, and unexpected cultural contact. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Weatherford, Genghis Khan and the Making of the Modern World
